headline: the zero API gate refused the paid run (paid_run_allowed false), and the reason is the answer to the question that was asked: in this configuration the plugin cannot remove unique content because its own literal guard forbids removing anything that uniquely carries a registered required literal

gate_result.paid_run_refused_in_practice: the runner refuses --pilot with 'refusing to send a paid request: ... paid_run_allowed=False'

barrier_1_budget_trigger_gate.state: addressed in v20: the gate now fires on every model input after the first, and the gate assertion passes with passthrough equal to one first call only
barrier_1_budget_trigger_gate.was: at the N3 shape two of three tasks never crossed the soft limit of 5435 tokens, so the filter was never invoked at all
barrier_1_budget_trigger_gate.note: trigger_gate_soft_limit_tokens reports 1 rather than 0 because the frozen class floors the value with max(1, ...); the semantics are unchanged

barrier_2_more_than_one_shadowed_method.my_spec_was_wrong: I told the implementer that re-opening the v5 entry point would suffice. It does not, and the implementer found this rather than assuming it

verified_independently_by_the_integrator.state_writer_table: last_elidable_indices is written only by RecencyBoundaryFilter.filter_items (openai_agents_recency_boundary_v7.py:190) and by the v10 variant, initialised empty at v7.py:165, and read as a criterion by v8 at openai_agents_long_baseline_boundary_v8.py:151
verified_independently_by_the_integrator.consequence: v5's filter_items calls self._filter, which resolves to v8's implementation, whose _output_decision returns 'within_recent_turns_kept_verbatim' for every index because the only writer of the eligible index set is the very method that v12 shadows; the state is therefore permanently empty and there is no decision point that can ever delete anything
verified_independently_by_the_integrator.measured: all three outputs keep reason within_recent_turns_kept_verbatim, while v5's own decision hook would have elided the first one

barrier_2_more_than_one_shadowed_method.not_done: populating that state would be a second change to the mechanism surface, beyond the single change the plan pre-registered, and it would still not produce a saving because of barrier 3

barrier_3_the_literal_guard_refuses_and_.what_happens: even with barrier 2 set aside, deleting the round 1 view on the N3 shape would remove occurrences of registered literals, and _carrier_loss (openai_agents_evidence_safe_retention_v5.py:822) reports registered_literal_lost, so the whole call falls back
barrier_3_the_literal_guard_refuses_and_.why_it_is_correct: 3.8.3 exists only in that one output, and 3.8.3 is a registered required literal; removing its only carrier would break the evidence bar that the strict track measures
barrier_3_the_literal_guard_refuses_and_.therefore: on a shape where each registered literal has exactly one carrier, this mechanism can remove zero bytes, for a literal safety reason rather than a wiring reason

characterisation.statement: in this host configuration the plugin is an evidence preserving redundancy remover: it removes exactly the part of the context that is redundant, and it refuses, by its own guard, to remove any content that uniquely carries a registered required literal
characterisation.byte_identical_duplicates_are_the_degene: when a whole output is repeated verbatim the redundant part is the entire output, which is why the exact duplicate rule was the only rule that ever moved a counter

this_single_sentence_explains_every_meas.sealed_confirmation_plus_12_54_percent: the protocol reads each registered view twice, so about half of the read payload in the baseline arm is redundant with content still present, and that is what is removed
this_single_sentence_explains_every_meas.N3_zero_percent: no output repeats, so there is nothing redundant, and the single candidate deletion is vetoed by the guard
this_single_sentence_explains_every_meas.45_of_45_strict_track: only redundant content is removed, so no unique evidence is ever lost
this_single_sentence_explains_every_meas.native_summary_minus_13_25_percent: its summaries are not redundant, they are additional tokens

characterisation.why_this_is_a_better_claim_than_context_: it is narrower, it is mechanically verifiable from the counters and the guard, and it is falsifiable: it predicts zero saving whenever the required evidence has a single carrier

decisions.do_not_remove_barrier_2: it would change the elision policy beyond the pre-registered single change, and barrier 3 would still veto on this shape
decisions.do_not_tune_the_guard: the guard is behaving exactly as designed; weakening it would trade the strict track for tokens, which is the one trade this project refuses
decisions.do_not_manufacture_redundancy: raising the headline by making the protocol read the same views more often is forbidden by the mechanism correction
decisions.stop_the_capability_pursuit: the capability question is answered; further headroom would require a new mechanism that compresses unique content while preserving evidence, which is a design effort rather than a measurement, or a registration whose literals are multiply carried
decisions.what_the_line_can_now_say: under this host configuration, on three sealed tasks at five repeats, this plugin removes redundant context and never removes uniquely carried required evidence: measured paired saving 12.54 percent with a bootstrap interval of 5.17 to 18.30 percent, 13 of 15 pairs positive and 45 of 45 strict track passes, against 0.00 percent on a shape with no redundancy

incidental_findings_recorded.inert_attribution_half_of_the_guard: v5._carrier_loss reads registry.SOURCES for the task, but the chain pins the task to a frozen registration id and openai_agents_multitask_chain_v14.py:78 only sets an empty tuple, so that half is inert for these tasks; this is true in v13 to v19 as well and was not introduced by v20; the plan's wording 'the literal guard is kept' is therefore broader than the implementation

pre_existing_test_failure.verified_by_the_integrator: it fails on its own in 10.45 seconds; the v20 files are not imported by any existing module
pre_existing_test_failure.cause: the v16 test expects the registry to record the reconciliation key unconditionally, while openai_agents_v17_registry.py:472-489 writes it only when the registered value differs from the public table and is the double hashed form; the third source registration corrected that value, so the branch no longer triggers
pre_existing_test_failure.not_drift: the current sha256 of the test file is 2365990fe4b96a77bb8db623e5dd719af73f1606cf6d665b09e891f6bec6a756 and it matches the pins recorded in V16_LIVE_PLAN, V16_LIVE_STUB, V17_LIVE_PLAN, V17_LIVE_STUB and V17_CAPABILITY_PROBE, so the file has not been modified
pre_existing_test_failure.consequence_for_reporting: the standing claim of '250 tests OK and 3 skipped' is stale for the current tree and must not be repeated without re-running the suite; the focused regression is 117 passed, 1 skipped and this 1 failure
pre_existing_test_failure.environment_correction: .venv has no pytest and .venv-openhands has no agents SDK, so the suite must be run as .venv-openhands python with PYTHONPATH pointing at .venv site-packages; my earlier instruction to use .venv for pytest was wrong
